results.title: Trump orders US aircraft carriers back to steam catapults as China, France advance EMALS technology
results.description: President Donald Trump has ordered the US Navy to replace the advanced electromagnetic catapult system used on its newest aircraft carriers with older steam-powered technology, according to a directive issued Thursday.
